content:
ben: Packaging window 03:15 UTC for private/vpc onprem. Target: signed installer + delta images. Need final cosign handoff and mirror propagation before seeding.

yasmin: I'm re-running shrinkwrap with dedup; found a leftover .debug file in arm64 layer. Stripping and retarring. ETA 6m.

clare: NOTE: mirror-bridge reorders small manifests under concurrent pulls. We'll enable chunk-seq header and add a small per-node jitter.

ops-nick: Ops guardrails: abort if >3 verify failures across any lane in 10m or sustained pull latency >100s for 4m. I'll stand watch and throttle if needed.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] staging pin created private-installer@v2024.09.02 -> sha256:aa55ff66bb77, upload s3://redwood-offline/releases/1822222222/ pending cosign.

package-bot: [package-bot] preflight: gzip OK, manifest schema OK, multi-arch tags present (amd64,arm64). Found arm64 .debug; packaging fixed.

yasmin: Repack done, checksums updated: new sha256:cc33dde4. Re-signing with KMS key installer-signer-05.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] cosign: signed by key=projects/prod/keys/installer-signer-05; cosign.pub uploaded to s3://redwood-offline/keys/cosign-2024-09.pub

clare: Pushing deterministic manifest ordering and chunk-seq header to packaging. Also enabling escort jitter=rand(0,1500ms). Non-blocking for canary.

ops-nick: Added alert rule: alert if verify_failures>2 in 5m OR avg_pull_latency>120s for 3m. Also auto-invalidate cosign cache on first seed.

ben: Canary plan: 3 lanes, 2 seeds per lane (6 seeds), seed spacing 80s, observe 25m. If canary passes -> roll batches of 6 every 12m.

package-bot: [package-bot] canary started: lanes=[red,green,blue], seeds=6, start_ts=1822222222, observe=25m.

package-bot: (8m) canary update: red OK, green partial (1 of 2 failed verify), blue OK. Fail cause: stale cosign.pub cached on that mirror node.

clare: Pushing pubkey to mirror-02 and forcing cache invalidation. Also a quick note: multipart uploads sometimes left with incomplete parts; packaging pipeline will now verify ETag counts before publish.

ops-nick: Cache invalidation applied to mirror-02. If the node fails verify after 2 retries, we'll evict and re-seed that seed.

package-bot: (16m) green recovered after invalidation. All seeds verified. Bandwidth by lane: red 52% burst, green 68% burst, blue 48%.

ben: Canary PASSED. Proceeding to rolling batches in +10m. Manual override allowed for pin updates if artifacts change.

package-bot: [package-bot] note: arm64 multipart had an orphan part; republished arm64 image -> new sha256:cc33dde4. deploy-bot requires manual unlock to update pin while controller lock in place.

ben: Manual override approved. deploy-bot please re-pin to sha256:cc33dde4 and append note to release notes: reason=arm64 multipart republish.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] pin updated: private-installer@v2024.09.02 -> sha256:cc33dde4. Change logged: user=ben reason="arm64 multipart republish". KMS-audit=KMS-2024-09-02-01

ops-nick: Rolling batches started: batch_size=6 pause_between=12m. Watching metrics closely.

clare: Post-release TODOs: add manifest-order unit test to packaging CI, add multipart completeness check, and document escort jitter default in delivery playbook. Filing tickets.

package-bot: (end) Rolling complete. No post-rollout evictions. Artifact TTL set to 90d. cosign.pub propagated to mirrors.

ben: Release notes broadcasted to private-customers list; included KMS audit id and artifact TTL. Thread closed unless someone sees a late blocker.

ops-nick: Final check: mirrors have cosign.pub and installer fallback will fetch key from KMS if local verify fails. Confirmed.

yasmin: Thanks all. Good run. :rocket:
